* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB6-L-imheretorescueyou-pre.gif]]), on the Players Committee's server by 25 February 2013<ref name="pc-img-date-Virtual6-Light">Players Committee card image folder (<code>Virtual6-Light/large/</code>), web-server directory listing sorted by date: every file last modified 25 February 2013, as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20190818034714/https://starwarsccg.org/cardlists/images/starwars/Virtual6-Light/large/?C=M;O=A 18 August 2019] (Internet Archive); the file is byte-identical to today's.</ref>: “If Rescue The Princess on table, LOST: Once per game, choose: Cancel an attempt to make non-Heroic R2-D2 lost. OR Lose 2 Force to cancel a battle just initiated if Leia defending alone. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: ▼ Cell 2187 and one always-[Immune to Alter] Effect. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the card image prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. The date is the bulk upload date of the whole image folder, so the image may have been made earlier; it is placed at that date (versions ruling of 11 November 2026: a PC card image is a version at its upload date). Document: the PC card image is a whole card (art, title bar, lore, icons, frame and set mark) and prints slip number “3•29” bottom right, as the release-sheet slip does.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[I'm Here To Rescue You (V) (Errata 2)]]): Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 34)<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=34 Internet Archive]</ref>, slip [[:File:VL-history-1263-29-front-master.png]]: “If Rescue The Princess on table, LOST: Once per game, choose: Cancel an attempt to make non-Heroic R2-D2 lost. OR Lose 2 Force to cancel a battle just initiated if Leia defending alone. (Immune to Sense.) STARTING: ▼ Cell 2187 and one always-[Immune to Alter] Effect. Place this Interrupt in hand.” '''What changed:''' nothing: the Master List prints the release-sheet words again, word for word. It is the last publication, so it is the current text; it is listed as its own version because it was published (versions rulings of 11 November 2026: every publication is a version, even a word-for-word repeat; whatever was published last is current). Document: the Master List slip prints no slip number.
